patch_description: Return to the proven CZ-chain architecture and stack it three times with shared parameters (ry_shared and rz_shared only). The first two blocks already achieved score 0.72; this tests whether a third identical block at constant parameter count can push beyond that threshold. The CZ interactions are more efficient than XX in this problem space, and aggressive parameter sharing (2 params across all 8 qubits, 3 blocks = 186 gates) maximizes the parameter_efficiency metric that dominates the combined score.
